about: Cases for Writing check, read by both ports: android/.../writing/WritingCheckTest.kt and ios/VocaPhoneTests/WritingCheckTests.swift. Offsets are UTF-16 units. Expected values were recorded from the Kotlin port, reviewed, and are binding on both. `model` maps a sentence to what the grammar model returns for it (null: still loading); a sentence not listed comes back unchanged. `accept` is the text left once every suggestion is accepted.

check.name: rules 1

suggestions.label: then → than
suggestions.message: “than” compares two things; “then” is about time or order.

check.text: I'd rather walk then drive.
